## match sample sizes
```{r}
library(MatchIt)
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: filter to C/I/M only
meta_cim <- metadata %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("C", "I", "M")) %>%
  mutate(
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group = factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group, levels = c("C", "I", "M")),
    FREG7_Gender = base::as.factor(FREG7_Gender)
  )

# Step 2 & 3: propensity score matching function
# Matches C and I to M (smallest group, n=69)
run_matched_sample <- function(data, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  match_out <- matchit(
    FREG5_Ethnic_Group ~ FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI,
    data = data,
    method = "nearest",
    distance = "glm",        # multinomial logistic PS
    ratio = 1,               # 1:1:1 matching
    replace = FALSE,
    caliper = 0.2,           # 0.2 SD of logit(PS)
    std.caliper = TRUE
  )
  
  matched_data <- match.data(match_out)
  return(matched_data$Participant_ID)
}
```


```{r}
# Step 4: check balance on one run first
library(MatchIt)
library(dplyr)

# --- helper: match one group to Malay reference ---
match_to_malay <- function(data, group_label, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group %in% c("M", group_label)) %>%
    mutate(is_malay = as.integer(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "M"))
  
  m <- matchit(
    is_malay ~ FREG8_Age + FREG7_Gender + BMI,
    data       = df,
    method     = "nearest",
    distance   = "glm",
    ratio      = 1,
    replace    = FALSE,
    caliper    = 0.2,
    std.caliper = TRUE
  )
  
  match.data(m)$Participant_ID
}

# --- single run to check balance first ---
ids_I <- match_to_malay(meta_cim, "I", seed = 42)
ids_C <- match_to_malay(meta_cim, "C", seed = 42)

# combined matched set: all M + matched I + matched C
# M appears in both calls — deduplicate
matched_ids <- unique(c(ids_I, ids_C))
meta_matched <- meta_cim %>% filter(Participant_ID %in% matched_ids)

table(meta_matched$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)  # should be ~69 / 69 / 69
```

```{r}
# Keep only Malays matched in both comparisons
malay_both <- base::intersect(
  ids_I[meta_cim$FREG5_Ethnic_Group[
    match(ids_I, meta_cim$Participant_ID)] == "M"],
  ids_C[meta_cim$FREG5_Ethnic_Group[
    match(ids_C, meta_cim$Participant_ID)] == "M"]
)

# Then rebuild matched set
matched_ids <- c(
  malay_both,
  ids_I[meta_cim$FREG5_Ethnic_Group[
    match(ids_I, meta_cim$Participant_ID)] == "I"],
  ids_C[meta_cim$FREG5_Ethnic_Group[
    match(ids_C, meta_cim$Participant_ID)] == "C"]
)

meta_matched <- meta_cim %>% filter(Participant_ID %in% matched_ids)
table(meta_matched$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)
```

```{r}
# Updated helper to extract matched IDs by group correctly
get_matched_ids <- function(data, seed) {
  
  ids_I <- match_to_malay(data, "I", seed = seed)
  ids_C <- match_to_malay(data, "C", seed = seed)
  
  # ethnicity lookup vector
  eth <- setNames(data$FREG5_Ethnic_Group, data$Participant_ID)
  
  malay_I <- ids_I[eth[ids_I] == "M"]
  malay_C <- ids_C[eth[ids_C] == "M"]
  indian   <- ids_I[eth[ids_I] == "I"]
  chinese  <- ids_C[eth[ids_C] == "C"]
  
  # only Malays matched in both comparisons
  malay_both <- intersect(malay_I, malay_C)
  
  c(malay_both, indian, chinese)
}
```
```{r}
# 500-iteration loop
set.seed(123)
seeds <- sample(1:100000, 500)

matched_id_list <- lapply(seeds, function(s) {
  tryCatch(
    get_matched_ids(meta_cim, s),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

matched_id_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), matched_id_list)
cat("Successful iterations:", length(matched_id_list), "\n")

# Quick sanity check on group sizes across iterations
size_check <- sapply(matched_id_list, function(ids) {
  table(meta_cim$FREG5_Ethnic_Group[
    match(ids, meta_cim$Participant_ID)])
})
cat("Median per-group n across iterations:\n")
print(apply(size_check, 1, median))
```

## beta diveresity
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(patchwork)

# ── distances ──────────────────────────────────────────────
bc_dist <- vegan::vegdist(abund_matched, method = "bray")

clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x <- x + 0.5
  log(x) - mean(log(x))
}
abund_clr     <- t(apply(abund_matched, 1, clr_transform))
aitchison_dist <- dist(abund_clr, method = "euclidean")

# ── PERMANOVA ──────────────────────────────────────────────
perm_bc <- vegan::adonis2(
  bc_dist ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group,
  data = meta_matched, permutations = 999
)

perm_ait <- vegan::adonis2(
  aitchison_dist ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group,
  data = meta_matched, permutations = 999
)

print(perm_bc)
print(perm_ait)

# ── PCoA plot function ─────────────────────────────────────
plot_pcoa <- function(dist_obj, dist_name, meta) {
  
  pcoa_obj <- ape::pcoa(dist_obj)
  var_exp  <- round(pcoa_obj$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    PC1       = pcoa_obj$vectors[, 1],
    PC2       = pcoa_obj$vectors[, 2],
    Ethnicity = meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group
  )
  
  # PERMANOVA label
  perm_obj <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist_obj ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group,
  data = meta, permutations = 999, by = "terms"
  )
  r2 <- round(perm_obj["FREG5_Ethnic_Group", "R2"], 3)
  pv <- perm_obj["FREG5_Ethnic_Group", "Pr(>F)"]
  lab <- paste0("PERMANOVA: R²=", r2,
                ", p=", ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(pv, 3)))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Ethnicity)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = matched_colors) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5,
             label = lab, size = 3.2, color = "grey30") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Beta diversity — ", dist_name, " (matched cohort)"),
      x     = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
      y     = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

# ── generate and combine plots ─────────────────────────────
p_bc  <- plot_pcoa(bc_dist,       "Bray-Curtis", meta_matched)
p_ait <- plot_pcoa(aitchison_dist, "Aitchison",  meta_matched)

p_bc
p_ait   # stacked; use p_bc | p_ait for side by side
```

## da analysis
```{r}
library(phyloseq)

library(MicrobiomeStat)

linda_out <- linda(
  feature.dat  = t(abund_matched),   # taxa as rows, samples as columns
  meta.dat     = meta_matched %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"),
  formula      = "~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group",
  alpha        = 0.05,
  p.adj.method = "BH",
  prev.filter  = 0.10
)

names(linda_out$output) 
linda_out$output# check contrast names
```

```{r}
# create one-vs-rest groupings
meta_matched <- meta_matched %>%
  mutate(
    C_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "C", "C", "non-C"),
    I_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "I", "I", "non-I"),
    M_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "M", "M", "non-M")
  )

# update phyloseq metadata
sample_data(ps_matched) <- sample_data(
  meta_matched %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID")
)

# ── function to run LinDA for one contrast ─────────────────
run_linda <- function(group_var, label) {
  
  res <- linda(
    feature.dat  = t(abund_matched),
    meta.dat     = meta_matched %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"),
    formula      = paste0("~ ", group_var),
    alpha        = 0.05,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    prev.filter  = 0.10
  )
  
  # extract the contrast (second level vs first)
  contrast_name <- names(res$output)[1]
  df <- res$output[[contrast_name]] %>%
    rownames_to_column("Species") %>%
    mutate(contrast = label) %>%
    filter(reject == TRUE) %>%        # significant after BH correction
    arrange(padj)
  
  return(df)
}

# ── run all three contrasts ────────────────────────────────
res_C <- run_linda("C_vs_rest", "C vs non-C")
res_I <- run_linda("I_vs_rest", "I vs non-I")
res_M <- run_linda("M_vs_rest", "M vs non-M")

# ── summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("C vs non-C significant species:", nrow(res_C), "\n")
cat("I vs non-I significant species:", nrow(res_I), "\n")
cat("M vs non-M significant species:", nrow(res_M), "\n")

# combine all significant species
sig_all <- bind_rows(res_C, res_I, res_M)
print(sig_all %>% select(Species, log2FoldChange, padj, contrast))
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ── function to extract full LinDA results (significant + not) ──
get_linda_full <- function(group_var, focal_group) {
  
  res <- linda(
    feature.dat  = t(abund_matched),
    meta.dat     = meta_matched %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"),
    formula      = paste0("~ ", group_var),
    alpha        = 0.05,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    prev.filter  = 0.10
  )
  
  contrast_name <- names(res$output)[1]
  df <- res$output[[contrast_name]] %>%
    rownames_to_column("Species") %>%
    mutate(
      sig      = reject == TRUE,
      direction = case_when(
        reject == TRUE & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ paste0("Enriched in ", focal_group),
        reject == TRUE & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ paste0("Depleted in ", focal_group),
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )
  return(df)
}

df_C <- get_linda_full("C_vs_rest", "C")
df_I <- get_linda_full("I_vs_rest", "I")
df_I

```
```{r}
plot_volcano <- function(df, focal_group) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj), 10),
      label_species  = ifelse(sig, Species, NA),
      dot_color = case_when(
        sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "red3",      # enriched in C
        sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "steelblue", # depleted in C
        TRUE                     ~ "grey80"
)
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj,
                 label = label_species)) +
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    
    geom_point(aes(color = I(dot_color),
                   size  = sig,
                   alpha = sig)) +
    scale_size_manual(values  = c("TRUE" = 2.8, "FALSE" = 1.2), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.4), guide = "none") +
    
    geom_text_repel(
      data          = df %>% filter(sig),
      size          = 3,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      box.padding   = 0.8,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      force         = 10,
      force_pull    = 0.5,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      segment.size  = 0.3,
      fontface      = "italic",
      direction     = "both"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Differential abundance: ", focal_group,
                        " vs non-", focal_group),
      subtitle = paste0("Matched cohort · LinDA · BH-corrected  |  ",
                        sum(df$sig & df$log2FoldChange < 0),
                        " enriched in ", focal_group, "  ·  ",
                        sum(df$sig & df$log2FoldChange > 0),
                        " depleted in ", focal_group),
      x        = paste0("Log2 fold change (negative = enriched in ", focal_group, ")"),
      y        = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))
    ) +
    
    # legend as colored text outside plot in top right
    scale_color_identity(
      guide  = "legend",
      labels = c("red3" = paste0("Enriched in ", focal_group),
                 "steelblue" = paste0("Depleted in ", focal_group),
                 "grey80" = "Not significant"),
      breaks = c("red3", "steelblue", "grey80")
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key       = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
    ))
}

p_volcano_C <- plot_volcano(df_C, "C")
p_volcano_I <- plot_volcano(df_I, "I")

p_volcano_C
p_volcano_I
```
